bullets.text: JPM flags Kaynes may confirm the OSAT scale-up from 2.3bn to 8bn chips at SEMICON (17-19 Sep) - a capacity re-rating catalyst.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - India EMS: Preview of the India SEMICON event this week

bullets.text: Kaynes' Sanand OSAT start slips to 3QFY27 on Mideast equipment and logistics delays, a timing risk not yet in numbers.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - India EMS: Preview of the India SEMICON event this week

bullets.text: Syrma (tracked, unscored) may announce a chips-packaging entry at SEMICON; Kaynes could also reveal a Japanese equipment tie-up.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - India EMS: Preview of the India SEMICON event this week

bullets.text: CLSA raises a board-independence governance flag on Coforge alongside a Rs2,170 target - a non-earnings catalyst on a covered IT name.
bullets.source: CLSA - 1 Min Research (16 Sep) + HSTECH + China Auto + AI

bullets.text: Samsung reportedly quoted Apple 30-40% higher DRAM prices for 1Q27 with DDR5 at record highs - AI is tightening memory supply.
AT&T reportedly sizing AI-era network capex at $250bn, another leg of the buildout Indian IT services demand rides on.
Crude spiked 4.2% overnight to $108.64/bbl on Saudi cargo cancellations and Russian refinery strikes - INR and the cement/metals fuel stack both pressured.
bullets.source: JPM - Overnight Brief 9/16: move higher in oil (+4.2% to $108.64/bbl)

bullets.text: Commodity open interest hit $2.1tn, a high since 2012 and energy-led - a broad positioning build, not an isolated oil spike.
bullets.source: JPM - Overnight Brief 9/16: move higher in oil (+4.2% to $108.64/bbl)

bullets.text: NSE F&O contracts fell 18% MoM in August, turnover -17% to Rs1.8tn and an 18-month low on the CAS rollout - thinner derivatives liquidity.
bullets.source: BofA - India Capital Market Watch: Subdued F&O activity, retail base expands

bullets.text: NPCI's new UPI MDR framework drew three broker notes overnight; Emkay names Paytm and Pine Labs as the beneficiaries.
bullets.source: Emkay - Internet: NPCI announces MDR on UPI - Paytm, Pine Labs to benefit (+2 more in Outlook)

bullets.text: Avendus Spark initiated IDFC First Bank at BUY (TP Rs107) and upgraded Five-Star Business Finance to BUY (TP Rs650).
bullets.source: Avendus Spark - Research 16 September 2026: IDFC First Bank initiation, FIVESTAR upgrade

ai_semis.text: SOX closed +0.40% - the AI complex steadied after the prior session's rotation, with AMD +2.2% the standout.
Bank of America argues investors misread AMD; the stock added 2.19% into the note.
ai_semis.source: TheStreet - Bank of America says investors get AMD stock wrong

ai_semis.text: Broadcom fell 1.58% even as its CEO publicly reaffirmed the large AI growth target.
ai_semis.source: GuruFocus - Broadcom CEO Doubles Down on Massive AI Growth Target
